summary: The hope hopes hoping account sees alignment’s core as social and worries about a crisis of meaning and the gap between AI makers and those affected.

statements.quote: i am increasingly unsure how we are going to close the gap between those making ai and those who will be most impacted.
Their models have always been my favorite and their vision for the future of AI — inclusive of risk and reward — resonates with me.
aspects of technical alignment are likely a solvable “engineering problem ” . but the thorny core is an intractable social and cultural one . and we are mostly unprepared
stuff like this reminds me how strategically and rhetorically unprepared the ai industry is for the scale and intensity of the crisis of meaning that is fast approaching.
i grow increasingly concerned about the default framing of china as an existential antagonist — true or not. seems like a dangerous path that precludes potential cooperation.
